title: Line sketch: Swirling Cosmic Vortex
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An abstract cosmic scene features fluid, organic swirls forming a central vortex in and tones.
